newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds & Reynolds drops on Q3 warnings.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds & Reynolds drops on Q3 warnings.

text.p: Shares of Reynolds & Reynolds Co dropped about 22 percent after the company said it expects its earnings for the current third quarter to fall short of analysts' expectations due to lower revenues in each of its principal businesses.
Reynolds & Reynolds, the most active issue on the New York Stock Exchange, dropped 4-3/8 to 15-3/8.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell also downgraded the stock to hold from buy.

Reynolds & Reynolds, which provides integrated information management systems, said its expects earnings for the quarter ending June 30 to be between $0.21 and $0.25 a share, excluding restructuring and other costs.
On a consensus basis, analysts expected Reynolds & Reynolds to earn $0.33 a share, compared to last year's third quarter earnings of of $0.57 a share.

Third quarter revenues are expected to be between $325 million and $340 million, which is higher than the year-earlier revenues of $287 million but a drop from the preceeding second quarter, Reynolds & Reynolds said.

The company said sales are also suffering because of the "tentativeness" of auto dealers in making buying decisions, various automotive manufacturer initiatives, slowing car sales and other related factors.
Separately, Reynolds & Reynolds said it signed agreements to buy the assets of two healthcare systems vendors.
